display_long_description:
Hello I am Baz and this is my flying sim. This is a game where you can go **really** fast with no physics constraints. You can learn how to do barrel rolls, backflips, frontflips, and more. 

At first you'll probably fly like a drunk superhero, but once you get the hang of it you'll be weaving between buildings and taking the riskiest paths.
[media]
# There are several gamemodes available
You can fly in an infinite procedurally generated city, you can fly with random people in multiplayer, and you can even fly around the Earth.


[media]
This is me flying in New York City using Googles Photorealistic 3D Tiles, but you can enter your own coordinates and fly anywhere in the world.

# But wait, theres more
There's destruction physics for every building. Fly too fast? Have fun going through 12 buildings.

[media]
# Take revenge on the buildings
You have an arsenal of tools to help you, including this cool laser

[media]

There's also like different powers and abilities and weapons, but yeah this is just the main stuff. That's all
